tools.name: check_building_availability
tools.description: Search a New York City business address. Returns up to five verified address candidates with signed address tokens and current eligibility. Ask the customer to select the correct building when there is more than one candidate. An unverified address requires manual review and cannot be ordered. Before placing an order, show the actual customer the exact building, bandwidth, monthly price, installation fee, survey requirement where applicable, term and linked service terms. Nearby orders use the standard installation fee for the selected bandwidth from the published Dedicated Internet schedule. Explain that feasibility, installation scope and timing require a site survey; special construction or changes to the displayed price or terms require separate approval before work begins. Never promise the connected-building online installation offer or timing for a Nearby order. Obtain that customer’s explicit acceptance and confirmation that they are authorized to order for the company. Never infer consent or authority from an availability or pricing inquiry.

address.description: New York City street address, including the building number and street name.

borough.description: New York City borough containing the address; select one of the listed values.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Read current published Dedicated Internet bandwidth prices, installation fees, initial term, billing and service terms. The result distinguishes the connected-building online installation offer from standard Nearby installation fees by bandwidth. Check the building before preparing an order. Before placing an order, show the actual customer the exact building, bandwidth, monthly price, installation fee, survey requirement where applicable, term and linked service terms. Nearby orders use the standard installation fee for the selected bandwidth from the published Dedicated Internet schedule. Explain that feasibility, installation scope and timing require a site survey; special construction or changes to the displayed price or terms require separate approval before work begins. Never promise the connected-building online installation offer or timing for a Nearby order. Obtain that customer’s explicit acceptance and confirmation that they are authorized to order for the company. Never infer consent or authority from an availability or pricing inquiry.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Recheck the explicitly selected building and create a signed, time-limited quote for a published bandwidth. This does not place an order. Show the returned review and linked terms to the actual customer before requesting acceptance. Before placing an order, show the actual customer the exact building, bandwidth, monthly price, installation fee, survey requirement where applicable, term and linked service terms. Nearby orders use the standard installation fee for the selected bandwidth from the published Dedicated Internet schedule. Explain that feasibility, installation scope and timing require a site survey; special construction or changes to the displayed price or terms require separate approval before work begins. Never promise the connected-building online installation offer or timing for a Nearby order. Obtain that customer’s explicit acceptance and confirmation that they are authorized to order for the company. Never infer consent or authority from an availability or pricing inquiry.

address_token.description: Signed address_token for the building explicitly selected from check_building_availability.

speed.description: Requested Dedicated Internet bandwidth in Gbps; choose one of the listed values.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Records the reviewed service order and queues staff and customer confirmations after validation. Connected-building orders are accepted; eligible nearby commercial buildings receive conditional orders with status pending_survey. Before placing an order, show the actual customer the exact building, bandwidth, monthly price, installation fee, survey requirement where applicable, term and linked service terms. Nearby orders use the standard installation fee for the selected bandwidth from the published Dedicated Internet schedule. Explain that feasibility, installation scope and timing require a site survey; special construction or changes to the displayed price or terms require separate approval before work begins. Never promise the connected-building online installation offer or timing for a Nearby order. Obtain that customer’s explicit acceptance and confirmation that they are authorized to order for the company. Never infer consent or authority from an availability or pricing inquiry. Pass accept_terms=true and authorized_to_order=true only after that explicit customer confirmation. Retry the same order_token after a network failure; never prepare a new order just to retry. No payment is collected at checkout.

order_token.description: Signed, time-limited order_token from prepare_order for the offer the customer reviewed.

name.description: Name of the customer contact authorized to place the order.

company.description: Legal or business name of the customer placing the order.

email.description: Customer contact email address for the order confirmation.

phone.description: Customer contact telephone number for the order.

suite.description: Floor, suite, or other location within the selected building.

details.description: Optional customer-provided notes relevant to the order.

preferred_installation_date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date, 4 to 90 calendar days from today in America/New_York. Stealth confirms scheduling.

accept_terms.description: Set to true only after the actual customer explicitly accepts the reviewed service terms and charges.

authorized_to_order.description: Set to true only after the actual customer explicitly confirms authorization to place this order.

tools.name: prepare_availability_inquiry
tools.description: Prepare a request for manual availability review, including unverified or off-network addresses. Supply an address token from a building check, or the entered address and NYC borough. This step sends nothing. Before sending an availability inquiry, show the actual customer the address, requested bandwidth, contact details, message and returned customer data notice. Obtain explicit approval to share them with Stealth. This requests a manual review; it does not place an order, confirm availability or promise installation timing. Never infer consent from an address search or pricing inquiry.

address_token.description: Signed address_token or inquiry_address_token returned by check_building_availability; use this instead of address and borough.

address.description: New York City street address, including building number and street name; provide with borough instead of address_token.

borough.description: Borough containing the entered address; provide with address instead of address_token.

speed.description: Requested bandwidth in Gbps; use 0 or omit when the customer is not sure yet.

tools.name: submit_availability_inquiry
tools.description: Save the customer-approved availability inquiry and queue staff and customer confirmations. Before sending an availability inquiry, show the actual customer the address, requested bandwidth, contact details, message and returned customer data notice. Obtain explicit approval to share them with Stealth. This requests a manual review; it does not place an order, confirm availability or promise installation timing. Never infer consent from an address search or pricing inquiry. Pass approve_submission=true only after that explicit approval. Retry the same inquiry_token after a network failure; never prepare another inquiry merely to retry.

inquiry_token.description: Signed, time-limited inquiry_token returned by prepare_availability_inquiry.

name.description: Name of the customer contact requesting the availability review.

email.description: Customer contact email address for the availability inquiry.

company.description: Optional customer business or organization name.

details.description: Optional customer-provided message or details for the availability review.

approve_submission.description: Set to true only after the actual customer explicitly approves sharing the reviewed inquiry and contact details with Stealth.
